2.23.0.name: proof
2.23.0.description: Create, edit, comment on, share, and run human-in-the-loop iteration loops over markdown documents via Proof's web API. Use when asked to "proof", "share a doc", "create a proof doc", "comment on a document", "suggest edits", "review in proof", "iterate on this doc in proof", "HITL this doc", "sync a Proof doc to local", when a caller needs an HITL review loop over a local markdown file (e.g., ce-brainstorm, ce-ideate, or ce-plan handoff), or when given a proofeditor.ai URL. Prefer this skill for any workflow whose output is a Proof URL or that uses a Proof doc as the review surface, even when not named explicitly.
